Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: PvP pressure, CC immunity, Seiton, warnings, assists, and target clarity.
Description: A local PvP HUD integrating a sharp HOWMANY-style pressure counter, stable native-nameplate pressure and CC-protection cues, Ninja Seiton decisions, configurable personal and MCH LB warnings with sound, opt-in CC-only one-shot Near Assist and Purify helpers, plus target highlights.
Changelog: CC protection visibility fix: active Guard and verified full immunity now use one large static crossed-CC emblem above the native job icon, with red prohibition stroke, bright side chevrons and separate countdown. Overlaps use the farthest expiry; no pulse, label clutter or world-position jitter.
